Benefits of the BMW EV lifestyle:

  • Flexible Fast Charger for charging at 120V or 240V outlet included with vehicle
  • Complimentary concierge service from America’s most experienced EV charging installer Qmerit: https://qmerit.com/ev/bmw/
  • Complimentary charging sessions at Electrify America’s 4,000+ fast charging stations nationwide*
  • The BMW ChargingNetwork allows you to charge seamlessly at 130,000+ charging points across North America with the My BMW App
  • You may be eligible for HOV lane access with a single occupant in select states
  • Calculate your financial benefits from gas savings and potential state and utility incentives: https://www.bmwusa.com/all-electric.html#savings-calculator
  • Use the MyBMW app to check your battery charge and available range, find nearby charging stations, and plan longer road trips with charging recommendations

* Restrictions and idle fees may apply. See https://www.electrifyamerica.com/bmw/ for more details.

Complimentary Public Charging:

  • Includes 2 years or 1,000 kWh of complimentary charging at Electrify America stations (whichever comes first)*
  • 1,000 kWh is an estimated 3,000 miles of driving based on average EPA values of i4, i5, and iX model variants. Miles may vary due to model configuration, driving style, and conditions.
  • With 4,000+ fast charging stations nationwide, Electrify America is the largest open DC Fast Charging network in the U.S.

* Restrictions and idle fees may apply. See https://www.electrifyamerica.com/bmw/ for more details.
